items.title: Update discord-bot chart version for smoother deployments in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the `discord-bot` blueprint's default `chart_version` from `0.1.1` to `0.1.4` in the seed script. The previous version was broken, causing deployment failures due to a missing ServiceAccount template. This change ensures that fresh seed runs will use the stable version, preventing potential regressions in production environments.
